title: Star Valley SMP
description: I’m Mia, and welcome to Star Valley 💖 A cozy survival server where you can claim land with a golden shovel, level up skills with MCMMO, enjoy custom fishing and cooking, and dive into tech and automation with Slimefun. Build your home, explore, and create
body: I’m Mia, and welcome to Star Valley 💖 A cozy survival server where you can claim land with a golden shovel, level up skills with MCMMO, enjoy custom fishing and cooking, and dive into tech and automation with Slimefun. Build your home, explore, and create your own adventure in a fun and friendly world. ✨
